subject: german

rounds.why: In German, “Silvester” is New Year's Eve (31 Dec). Christmas Eve is “Heiligabend”.

rounds.lie: “Das gefällt mir gar nicht” means “I quite like that”.
rounds.why: “Gar nicht” means “not at all”, so it means “I don't like that at all”.
rounds.truth: “Das gefällt mir gar nicht” means “I don't like that at all”.
truths: “Ich interessiere mich für Musik” means “I am interested in music”.
“Ich treffe mich mit Freunden” means “I meet up with friends”.

rounds.why: “Eine Sendung” is a TV/radio programme. A sentence is “ein Satz”.

rounds.lie: “Eigentlich mag ich Popmusik” means “Currently I like pop music”.
rounds.truth: “Eigentlich mag ich Popmusik” means “Actually, I like pop music”.
truths: “Wir feiern Weihnachten mit der Familie” means “We celebrate Christmas with the family”.

rounds.lie: “Gestern bin ich zu einem Konzert gegangen” means “Tomorrow I will go to a concert”.
rounds.why: “Bin... gegangen” is the perfect tense = “I went”. “Tomorrow I will go” is “Morgen gehe ich / werde ich gehen”.
rounds.truth: “Gestern bin ich zu einem Konzert gegangen” means “Yesterday I went to a concert”.
truths: “Das Oktoberfest” is a folk festival in Munich.
“Ich folge vielen Influencern” means “I follow many influencers”.

rounds.why: “Ein Lied” means “a song”. A singer is “ein Sänger”.
